summary: All six dimensions pass. The page aligns with its plan brief and covers all four assigned subsections without scope drift. Each subsection addresses the assigned workflow role (assigned process owner), input (current process records and relevant evidence), decision (determine ownership, acceptance and next action), record (documented decision and its owner), and exception (missing evidence, conflicting ownership or unavailable access). The illustrative manufacturer example appears in all four subsections, is correctly labeled as hypothetical, and is never presented as a measured customer result. Citations to the ICC processes page and ISO APG source are accurate, support their sentences, and use only the two supplied source URLs plus one permitted internal site path. Vendor descriptions are consistently distinguished from verified installed behavior throughout. No FAQ section appears, which is correct as none is assigned. Prose is clear and readable with no significant repetition across sections.
